patients.summary: Healthy environmental consultant with seasonal allergic rhinitis who joined in 2022. Two preterm deliveries by cesarean (32 weeks in 2024, infant with RDS who went home; 34 weeks in 2026, newborn died of RDS) with a high-altitude pulmonary edema ED visit in between. Last seen mid-second pregnancy in May 2026.

documents.title: New Patient Inquiry
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller would like to move her primary care here. Her old doctor retired in the spring and she has not had a physical since 2021. Works as an environmental consultant, mostly remote with some field days, so mornings are easiest. Membership info emailed. Booked a new-patient physical for 9/12 at 8:30. Records release form sent to her email; she will sign and return so we can request the prior office's chart. BCBS PPO card photo uploaded.

documents.title: New Patient Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
30 y/o woman transferring care; prior PCP retired. Feels well. Here to set up care and get a baseline physical.

PMH: seasonal allergic rhinitis since college, sneezing/itchy eyes/clear rhinorrhea in April-May and again late August. Uses levocetirizine 5 mg OTC daily through the season, works well, no sedation. No asthma, no eczema.
PSH: R knee arthroscopy at 24 (2016), full recovery.
OB/GYN: G0. Regular cycles. No contraception concerns today. Last Pap with HPV 2020 at prior office, she believes normal; records requested.
Meds: levocetirizine 5 mg daily in season. No supplements.
Allergies: latex (rash with gloves); penicillin (told as a child, she does not know what happened).
FHx: mother had a baby early (preterm) and has seasonal allergies. Father HTN and type 2 diabetes. Maternal aunt reportedly very prone to altitude lung trouble, was told she should not climb high.
SHx: married, no children. Environmental consultant, site assessments and remote report writing. Never smoker. 1-2 drinks a week, socially. Runs and hikes. No drug use.

ROS negative except seasonal nasal symptoms.

Exam: well appearing. Vitals as recorded, BMI about 22. HEENT: TMs clear, nasal mucosa pink, no polyps. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement. Heart RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear throughout. Abdomen soft, nontender. Skin without rashes. R knee with healed portal scars, full ROM, stable. Mood and affect normal.

Assessment/plan:
1. Preventive care, 30F. Fasting labs today: CBC, CMP, lipids, TSH, A1c given father's diabetes. One-time HIV and hep C screening, she agrees. PHQ-2 0. Pap due 2025 if 2020 cotest was normal; will confirm from records. Flu and the fall COVID booster at a nurse visit next month when stock arrives.
2. Seasonal allergic rhinitis: controlled on levocetirizine in season. Continue.
3. Allergies reconciled: latex and penicillin entered.
Return in a year for a physical.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Delaney, all of your bloodwork came back in the normal range: blood counts, kidney and liver tests, thyroid, sugar (A1c) and cholesterol. HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Nothing to change. Enjoy the rest of September.

documents.title: Prior Primary Care Records
documents.author: outside primary care
documents.body:
Records from prior primary care office, 2016 through 2021, received on signed release.

Summary of relevant items:
- Annual visits 2017-2021, healthy adult. Problem list: seasonal allergic rhinitis.
- Allergies on file: latex (rash); penicillin (reaction not documented, childhood).
- 2016: right knee arthroscopy (outside orthopedics), uneventful recovery noted at follow-up.
- Tdap 2019.
- Cervical cytology with HPV co-testing 2020-06: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy; high-risk HPV not detected.
- Influenza vaccine most years; COVID-19 primary series 2021 per state registry printout.

Filed to chart. Pap 2020 normal confirms next screening in 2025.

documents.title: Immunization Visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Here for seasonal flu and bivalent COVID booster. Screening questions reviewed, no contraindications; latex-free gloves and bandage used per allergy flag. Flu IM left deltoid, COVID IM right deltoid. VIS given. Waited 15 minutes, no reaction. Left feeling fine.

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Pollen season is heavier this year and she spent two weeks doing soil sampling along a river corridor. Sneezing, watery itchy eyes, clear drainage. Restarted levocetirizine in mid April and it has taken most of the edge off; worst on field days. No fever, facial pain, wheeze or cough. Sleeping fine.

O: afebrile, vitals reviewed. Conjunctivae mildly injected. Nasal turbinates pale and boggy, clear mucus. No sinus tenderness. Pharynx clear. Lungs clear, no wheeze.

A/P: seasonal allergic rhinitis, typical spring flare. Continue levocetirizine 5 mg nightly through the season. Shower and change after field work, keep car windows up on high-count days. Call if symptoms break through or she develops wheezing.

documents.title: Annual Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual exam, 31F. Doing well. Allergies were manageable this year once she started levocetirizine early; finishing the late-summer stretch now and will stop it after the first frost. Running 3x/week.

They are starting to think about a pregnancy, possibly early next year. Discussed coming in before trying so we can start a prenatal vitamin with folate and go over vaccines and labs.

Meds: levocetirizine 5 mg daily seasonally. Allergies: latex, penicillin. No change in family history. Never smoker, alcohol 1-2/week.

Exam: vitals in chart, weight steady. HEENT normal. Neck no thyroid enlargement or nodes. Cardiac RRR, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen benign. Extremities without edema. Skin: no worrisome moles on full survey.

Plan:
- CBC, BMP, lipids, A1c (family history of diabetes).
- PHQ-2 negative.
- Pap not due until 2025.
- Flu + updated COVID at a nurse visit in October.
- Preconception visit when ready.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Delaney, your labs are all reassuring again this year, A1c and cholesterol included. No follow-up needed. Let us know when you want to set up the preconception visit.

documents.title: Immunization Visit
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Flu (L arm) and 2023-24 COVID (R arm) given IM. Latex precautions observed. No prior reactions. Observed 15 min, tolerated well. Registry updated.
